outline.text: How to spell check in Microsoft Word
Create a new document or open an existing file in Word for the web.
Enter text or copy and paste text onto a page to edit a pre-written document.
Find all spelling mistakes underlined in red.
Review spelling errors and select a spelling recommendation to replace.
Proofread text to fix last-minute errors.
Save and share as a Word document link or export as a PDF for printing.
